summary.text: Says Dexter will fight for working families, living wages, union jobs, affordable housing, and childcare.
summary.quote: Working families, not billionaires: Good schools, living wages, union jobs, affordable housing and childcare.

summary.text: Says Dexter believes healthcare is a human right and will support abortion, vaccinations, and gender-affirming care.
summary.quote: Healthcare is a human right: High quality, accessible and affordable care for all. Keep politicians out of exam rooms and let science guide care.

summary.text: Says Dexter will work to protect voting rights, end corruption, and remove dark money from politics.
summary.quote: Democracy: Protect voting rights. End corruption. Defend our communities from authoritarianism. Get dark money out of politics.
